entries.title: Proverbs 22:1
segments: ¶A [good] name is to be chosen rather than great riches, Loving favor rather than silver and gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:2
segments: ¶The rich and the poor have this in common, The LORD [is] the maker of them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:3
segments: ¶A prudent [man] foresees evil and hides himself, But the simple pass on and are punished.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:4
segments: ¶By humility [and] the fear of the LORD [Are] riches and honor and life.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:5
segments: ¶Thorns [and] snares [are] in the way of the perverse; He who guards his soul will be far from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:6
segments: ¶Train up a child in the way he should go, And when he is old he will not depart from it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:7
segments: ¶The rich rules over the poor, And the borrower [is] servant to the lender.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:8
segments: ¶He who sows iniquity will reap sorrow, And the rod of his anger will fail.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:9
segments: ¶He who has a generous eye will be blessed, For he gives of his bread to the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:10
segments: ¶Cast out the scoffer, and contention will leave; Yes, strife and reproach will cease.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:11
segments: ¶He who loves purity of heart [And has] grace on his lips, The king [will be] his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:12
segments: ¶The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, But He overthrows the words of the faithless.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:13
segments: ¶The lazy [man] says, "[There is] a lion outside! I shall be slain in the streets!"

entries.title: Proverbs 22:14
segments: ¶The mouth of an immoral woman [is] a deep pit; He who is abhorred by the LORD will fall there.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:15
segments: ¶Foolishness [is] bound up in the heart of a child; The rod of correction will drive it far from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:16
segments: ¶He who oppresses the poor to increase his [riches, And] he who gives to the rich, [will] surely [come] to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:17
segments: ¶Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise, And apply your heart to my knowledge;

entries.title: Proverbs 22:18
segments: For [it is] a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; Let them all be fixed upon your lips,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:19
segments: So that your trust may be in the LORD; I have instructed you today, even you.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:20
segments: Have I not written to you excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:21
segments: That I may make you know the certainty of the words of truth, That you may answer words of truth To those who send to you?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:22
segments: ¶Do not rob the poor because he [is] poor, Nor oppress the afflicted at the gate;

entries.title: Proverbs 22:23
segments: For the LORD will plead their cause, And plunder the soul of those who plunder them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:24
segments: ¶Make no friendship with an angry man, And with a furious man do not go,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:25
segments: Lest you learn his ways And set a snare for your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:26
segments: ¶Do not be one of those who shakes hands in a pledge, One of those who is surety for debts;

entries.title: Proverbs 22:27
segments: If you have nothing [with which] to pay, Why should he take away your bed from under you?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:28
segments: ¶Do not remove the ancient landmark Which your fathers have set.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:29
segments: ¶Do you see a man [who] excels in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before unknown [men].
